decision.reason: Adding the local U(1) constrained sector changes field/gauge content. The audited parent beta-function calculations cannot be promoted to the HMT A,nu theory without an explicit gauge-fixed one-loop derivation or an equivalence theorem for the Hessian, constraints and ghosts.
